{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and deduplicate the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Compute overall response rate in treatment and control arms
rate_treatment = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment', 'responded'].mean()
rate_control = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control', 'responded'].mean()

# Compute the difference (treatment - control)
difference = rate_treatment - rate_control

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Overall response rate - treatment: {rate_treatment:.4f}')
print(f'Overall response rate - control: {rate_control:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (treatment - control): {difference:.4f}')"}
